items.question: How does Imperium Club work?
items.answer: Imperium Club is an investment platform that offers daily returns through various investment plans. You choose a plan, make your deposit, and start receiving daily returns until you reach 300% of your initial investment.

items.question: Is it safe to invest in Imperium Club?
items.answer: Yes, our platform uses advanced encryption, insurance funds, and regular audits to ensure the security of your investments. Additionally, we have a dedicated team for security and compliance.

items.question: What deposit methods are available?
items.answer: We accept various cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), USD Coin (USDC), and other popular altcoins. We are also constantly adding new payment options.

items.question: How do withdrawals work?
items.answer: Withdrawals are processed according to your investment plan. Basic plans may take up to 48 hours, while premium plans have withdrawals within 6 hours. Leadership plans feature instant withdrawals.

items.question: What is the referral program?
items.answer: Our referral program allows you to earn generous bonuses by bringing new investors to the platform. Commissions range from 5% to 15% depending on your plan, and you also earn commissions on your network's referrals.

items.question: Can I have multiple investments?
items.answer: Yes, you can have multiple active investments simultaneously in different plans. This allows you to diversify your portfolio and optimize your returns according to your financial goals.

items.question: How are returns calculated?
items.answer: Returns are calculated daily based on your plan's rate and are automatically credited to your account. Rates vary from 0.2% to 0.8% per day, depending on the chosen plan.

items.question: Are there any hidden fees?
items.answer: No, we are completely transparent about our fees. The only fee applied is a small processing commission for withdrawals, which is clearly informed before transaction confirmation.

items.question: How does customer support work?
items.answer: We offer 24/7 support through email, live chat, and phone. Premium plans include priority support and dedicated managers for personalized assistance.

items.question: Can I cancel my investment at any time?
items.answer: Yes, you can request the cancellation of your investment at any time. However, remember that returns are calculated until the cancellation date and there may be processing fees.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.description: Our support team is ready to help. Contact us and get all your questions answered.

helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.subtitle: Find answers to your questions
helpCenter.whatIsImperiumContent: Imperium Club is an automated investment platform that offers access to professional institutional-level trading for common investors. Our mission is to transform investors into long-term wealth builders through secure and automated solutions.
helpCenter.howToStartContent: To get started: 1) Create your free account. 2) Complete your profile with basic information. 3) Choose an investment plan. 4) Make your first deposit. 5) Track your daily yields. The whole process takes less than 5 minutes!
helpCenter.availablePlansContent: We offer 3 plans: Start ($500+), Basic ($1,000+) and Silver ($2,000+). Each plan offers different daily yield rates and exclusive benefits. All plans include fast withdrawals and dedicated support.
helpCenter.createAccountContent: Click 'Sign Up' in the top menu. Fill in your personal details, create a secure password and confirm your email. After confirmation, you will have full access to the platform.
helpCenter.resetPasswordContent: On the login page, click 'Forgot my password'. Enter your registered email and we will send a recovery link. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.
helpCenter.updateProfileContent: Access your profile in the side menu. There you can update personal information, banking details, notification settings and security preferences. Save the changes at the end.
helpCenter.howYieldsWorkContent: Yields are calculated daily based on your plan and invested amount. Rates vary from 1% to 3% per day. Yields are automatically credited to your account and you can withdraw at any time.
helpCenter.withdrawalProcessContent: Access the investments area, click 'Withdraw' and choose the amount. Withdrawals are processed within 24 hours. Minimum withdrawal: $50. Fees may apply depending on the chosen method.
helpCenter.compoundInterestContent: Compound interest means your daily yields are automatically reinvested, generating more yields the next day. This creates a snowball effect that accelerates your financial growth.
helpCenter.supportAvailable: Our support team is available 24/7 to help with any questions
